productBefore.README.md:
# Presence connector

A socket can synchronously emit its initial `presence` inside `connect()`. The connector must deliver every presence from connection start until disposal. A failed connect must leave no listener behind. The returned disposer detaches only this subscription. Preserve the public connectPresence(socket, onPresence) interface.
